title: No unsubstantiated superlatives
description: Superlatives such as "#1", "best" or "leading" need an approved fact that backs them.

title: Claims must not contradict approved facts
description: A claim that the approved-facts registry says is false (wrong number, fee or capability) must be corrected before publication.

title: Use current facts only
description: A claim that matches a superseded fact must be updated to the current approved value.

title: Factual claims need an approved fact
description: Numbers, capabilities and other factual claims must be backed by an entry in the approved-facts registry.

title: No absolute security or safety claims
description: Never claim absolute security or safety ("100% secure", "completely safe", "unhackable"). Describe the specific protection instead.
config: {"patterns": ["100% secure", "100% safe", "completely safe", "completely secure", "totally secure", "fully secure", "unhackable", "zero risk", "risk-free"], "fallback": "bank-grade encrypted"}

title: No guaranteed-outcome language
description: Do not promise outcomes ("guaranteed returns", "never worry again"). Describe what the product does.
config: {"patterns": ["guaranteed returns", "guaranteed approval", "guaranteed", "never worry again", "always approved", "never fails"], "fallback": "pay with confidence"}

title: "Free" needs a fact or the offer disclaimer
description: Any use of "free" must be backed by an approved fact or carry the offer disclaimer "T&C apply."

title: Approved product names
description: Product names must use the approved spelling and capitalisation from the terminology list.

title: Banned and discouraged words
description: Banned words ("cheap", "hassle-free guaranteed", "no risk", "instant loan") must not appear. Discouraged words should be replaced.

title: Match the PayWise voice
description: Tone must match the voice profile. A trait that deviates from its target by more than 0.3 is flagged.

title: Restrained punctuation and capitals
description: At most one exclamation mark per 100 words, and no all-caps words longer than 4 letters.

title: Offer disclaimer
description: Any offer, cashback or "free" mention requires "T&C apply."

title: Pay Later eligibility disclaimer
description: Any PayWise Pay Later mention requires "Subject to eligibility."

title: LinkedIn limits
description: LinkedIn posts: at most 3,000 characters and 5 hashtags.

title: X limits
description: Posts on X: at most 280 characters and 2 hashtags.

title: Email subject length
description: Email subject lines: at most 60 characters.

title: Readable consumer copy
description: Consumer-channel copy must have a Flesch Reading Ease score of 50 or higher.

title: Use the brand palette
description: Colours covering more than 8% of a visual must be within ΔE00 10 of a PayWise brand colour.

title: Never stretch or squash the logo
description: Scale the logo proportionally. A width-to-height change of more than 5% is a misuse.

title: Keep clear space around the logo
description: Keep empty space of at least a quarter of the logo's height on every side of it.

title: Text must meet WCAG 2.2 contrast
description: Text in visuals needs a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text (WCAG 2.2 AA).

title: Every image needs alt text
description: Images in emails and documents need alt text, so screen-reader users get the same message.

title: Write useful alt text
description: Alt text describes what the image shows and says. No file names, no "image of", no single words.
